name: Fade Up
description: The first clip rises, grows and fades out over the second through a zoom blur and a gentle wave, with a short exposure flash at the start. Recreation of the CapCut "Fade Up" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; sets how far the wave travels
